# Angel Hermon

> Software engineer. Landing pages and small sites for dev-tool and indie-SaaS founders, plus open-source agent tooling (Go, Rust, Python, TypeScript). Static HTML/CSS/vanilla JS, built with an AI-agent pipeline that Angel reviews.

## Pages
- [Home](https://anhermon.dev/): overview and selected work
- [Work](https://anhermon.dev/work/): index of case studies
- [Services](https://anhermon.dev/services/): landing pages for dev-tool and SaaS founders (draft)
- [Code](https://anhermon.dev/code/): open-source agent tooling
- [Redesign Lab](https://anhermon.dev/redesign/): before/after redesign experiments
- [Notes](https://anhermon.dev/notes/): a monthly email
- [Contact](https://anhermon.dev/contact/)
